docs.doc: Story requirements: automated forecast updates triggered by document ingestion, incremental updates, 5-minute completion, user notifications.
Implementation timeline: Story 4.3 in Weeks 9-10. Automated forecast updates on document ingestion per FR20.
DocumentMetadata model at shared/models.py:11-22 with filename, doc_type, reporting_period fields for metric identification.
New code must have 80%+ test coverage. CI/CD enforces coverage gate. All unit/integration tests must pass.
Story 4.2 learnings: ForecastingAgent integrated, Mistral Large LLM pattern, Prophet 8-quarter minimum, 92.18% coverage achieved.

constraints.constraint: File location: raglite/forecasting/auto_update.py (~50-75 lines target per architecture guidelines)
Direct SDK usage only - NO custom wrappers or abstraction layers per CLAUDE.md anti-over-engineering rules
FR20: Forecast refresh triggered on document ingestion. AC3: Total time under 5 minutes.
Prophet requires minimum 8 data points (2 years quarterly). Handle InsufficientDataError gracefully.
Use Mistral Large (mistral-large-latest) for LLM reasoning - maintain consistency with Stories 4.1/4.2.
Integration tests use test database (port 6335 Qdrant, port 5433 PostgreSQL) per Story 4.0.5.
New code must have 80%+ test coverage (DoD requirement). Previous stories achieved 88-92%.
Settings must be configurable via environment variables (enable_forecast_auto_update, forecast_refresh_timeout).
